name: pocketpal_ak_tokens_v1
purpose: Compact action/content protocol for tiny local models. The model may emit AK tokens; PocketPal materializes JSON and runtime actions outside the model.

copy_tokens.<AK_COPY_USER_SOURCE_1>: copy current user source text exactly
copy_tokens.<AK_COPY_USER_SOURCE_N>: reserved for future source-slot copies, N=1..24

runtime_contract.model: Choose action and compact content/operator tokens.
runtime_contract.app: Validate, repair, copy source slots, fill JSON metadata, and execute/ask for approval where needed.
runtime_contract.json: Transport format only; not required as native model output.
